reviewer.origin: Agent tool, a fresh context with only this brief and its files, launched by the Inner Child lane session (https://claude.ai/code/session_01NbUfhcTaRT8sbjyYV1wEFq), turn 113, 2026-10-26

evidence: Judged "If you'd rather stop" over "Not wanting to do it anymore might be reason enough, but if that 'nope' sounds like a part of you that's trying to protect you, I'd hear it out first": the heading names the case in other words, gives "reason enough" and "do it anymore" their object (stopping, as in "(stopping counts)" in the paragraph above), and adds no claim, while the "And if you keep following..." half now sits under its own heading, so no line is cut from the line it answers. No linter findings or PRESENT rows were given and I find none: the heading shares no word with its paragraph (T26 absent; the echo of "stopping" above links the two cases usefully), and T10 and T22 are not happening in a four-word heading. The section's five headings mix forms ("When...", "If...", a question in Joel's voice) and read as the cases a stalled reader really has, not a coverage taxonomy.
